name: Set CPU-derived job budgets
run:
set -euo pipefail
cpus="$(nproc)"
test "$cpus" -gt 0
campaign=$(( cpus < 4 ? cpus : 4 ))
simulations=$(( cpus < 4 ? cpus : 4 ))
tool_build=$(( cpus < 8 ? cpus : 8 ))
{
  printf 'CI_BUILD_JOBS=%s\n' "$cpus"
  printf 'CI_TOOL_BUILD_JOBS=%s\n' "$tool_build"
  printf 'CI_CAMPAIGN_JOBS=%s\n' "$campaign"
  printf 'VERILATOR_JOBS=%s\n' "$cpus"
  printf 'SIM_JOBS=%s\n' "$simulations"
  printf 'MAKEFLAGS=-j1 --no-print-directory\n'
} >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

name: Link health, wording, dead-reference and local-info gate
Added-line em-dash gate
run:
set -euo pipefail
case "$EVENT_NAME" in
  pull_request)
    if [ -z "$PR_BASE_REF" ]; then
      echo "the pull_request event names no base branch"; exit 2
    fi
    git fetch --quiet origin "$PR_BASE_REF"
    base="$(git merge-base HEAD FETCH_HEAD || true)"
    ;;
  push) base="$PUSH_BEFORE_SHA" ;;
  *) echo "a $EVENT_NAME event carries no base to judge from"; exit 2 ;;
esac
if [ -z "$base" ] || [ "$base" = 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 ]; then
  echo "the $EVENT_NAME event names no base commit"; exit 2
fi
git cat-file -e "$base^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || git fetch --quiet --depth=1 origin "$base"
python3 scripts/check_em_dash.py --base "$base"

name: Install the pinned sv2v release
run:
set -euo pipefail
ver=v0.0.12
sha256=ff8c9eea5bc029b372fb4953427625cddb7cf7e58c1240623ac9f260818d5a00
url="https://github.com/zachjs/sv2v/releases/download/${ver}/sv2v-Linux.zip"
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-sv2v-cache"
archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/ci-sv2v-cache/sv2v.zip"
if [ ! -f "$archive" ]; then curl -fsSL "$url" -o "$archive"; fi
echo "${sha256}  $archive" | sha256sum -c -
unzip -q -o "$archive" -d /tmp/sv2v
sudo install -m755 "$(find /tmp/sv2v -name sv2v -type f | head -1)" \
  /usr/local/bin/sv2v
sv2v --version
